## What we are going to see {.inverse background-color="#1F4257"}

Purpose of this class is to introduce <span style="color:#E8741E;">**what is**</span> Machine Learning — what are the techniques involved, how they work, and how to understand (and <span style="color:#E8741E;">**trust**</span>) their results. We'll also look at <span style="color:#E8741E;">**some examples**</span> and <span style="color:#E8741E;">**best practices**</span> in conducting a machine-learning project.

The class will cover from simple *classical* techniques to large language models, including agents.

<br/>

My principal aim is to give you the tools to start <span style="color:#E8741E;">**understanding**</span> and <span style="color:#E8741E;">**evaluating**</span> the quality of a machine-learning project when used for clinical purposes, possibly regardless of its complexity.

<br/>

> <span style="color:#E8741E;">**Disclaimer:**</span> today I do not show you any code.

::: {.notes}
Slide-mission dell'originale. La tengo verbatim a parte la sostituzione dell'arancio (theme attuale). Il *disclaimer* sul codice è importante: questo è l'Overview *concettuale*; chi vuole la parte pratica frequenta il corso *Practical AI for Medical Data Analyses with R* (basic + advanced).
:::

## <span style="color:#E8741E;">Overview</span> {.inverse background-color="#1F4257"}

- **Introduction** — what does "Machine Learning" mean?
- **Classifiers**
- **MLT Examples**
- Model <span style="color:#E8741E;">**selection**</span> and **evaluation**
- **Neural Networks** and <span style="color:#E8741E;">**Deep** Learning</span>
- <span style="color:#E8741E;">**Unstructured** data</span> (e.g., images, text)
- **Large** <span style="color:#E8741E;">**Language Models**</span>, ChatGPT, and Agents
- **Best practices** for implementing Machine Learning

::: {.notes}
Indice del corso — stesso ordine del deck originale, tarato sui 10 capitoli del manifest (qui ho 8 voci perché *MLT Examples* copre cap. 03, *Deep Learning* copre cap. 05+06, *LLM/ChatGPT/Agents* copre 07+08+09). Lo cito in 30 secondi: l'orizzonte è 4 ore lorde, distribuite in tre macro-blocchi: *capire come funziona* → *vedere cosa fanno i sistemi moderni* → *usarli con giudizio*.
:::
